newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean shares end down on eletricity price row.
newsitem.headline: Chilean shares end down on eletricity price row.

text.p: Chilean stocks closed sharply lower with the bolsa dragged down by a slide in electricity shares on news two firms have sought court orders to force the government to review plans to cut prices, said traders.
The jitters in the electricity sector are expected to undermine the market further at the opening, they said.
"The market is very delicate. There are fears that this legal battle over the prices will drag on," said one trader.
The 40-share IPSA index ended down 1.03 percent at 100.53 points. The general IGPA index lost 0.55 percent to 5,486.68 points amid volume of 9.2 billion pesos.
